_doc: Single source of truth for the alert guardrail. Read by ai-service/gajamitra/policy.py and by the Spring Boot re-check. See docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, Phase 2 step 5. send_now_severity is the exact level sent at once (the guard raises or lowers proposals to it); escalation_severity is the level a proposed escalation is sent at, held for approval when hold_escalation is true and the site requires approval; max_severity is the highest level any alert may have.
